summary: Frontend-only regression check of the two additive changes (7 stage icons + scroll-linked SectionWipe hairlines) at 1440x900, 768x1024 and 390x844 on the preview URL. ALL requested checks PASS. (1) No horizontal overflow: documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth exactly at all three widths (1440/1440, 768/768, 390/390); re-sampled every 500px through the whole pinned process scene and every 700px through a full top-to-bottom scroll at each width - max scrollWidth never exceeded the viewport width (390 stayed 390 throughout). (2) Seven-stage process still works: exactly 7 [data-panel-card] at all widths; counter advanced cleanly 01->02->03->04->05->06->07 at 1440 (process-progress-counter), 768 and 390 (process-progress-counter-mobile now exists and is visible; desktop testid present but hidden at 390 as expected), and stage <h3> titles advanced in order Discovery & Alignment -> Scope & Roadmap Lock -> Design -> Engineering & Build -> Testing & Hardening -> Launch & Handover -> Post-Launch Support. (3) Icons: each of the 7 cards contains exactly one inline <svg> (svg-per-card = [1,1,1,1,1,1,1] at all three widths); rendered 20x20, opacity 1, currentColor resolves to accent rgb(214,63,10) inside the circular chip in the card header row - visually confirmed in screenshot. (4) SectionWipe: exactly one h-px origin-left gradient span in each of #address, #beliefs, #process and #clients; verified scrubbed animation - computed transform goes matrix(0,0,0,1,0,0) at start ('top 92%') to matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) by 'top 45%' for all four. (5) Hero H1 renders full sentence, client-type-0/1/2, cta-button and <footer> all present and visible after scrolling to bottom at all three widths. (6) Zero pageerror and zero console errors across all viewport runs (load + full scroll).

issues: Minor cosmetic desync: in one sampled frame the visible card read stage '02 Scope & Roadmap Lock' while the right-hand rail counter still read '01' (rail counter lags the card during the scrubbed transition). Not a functional failure - full 01->07 sequence is emitted - but the rail number and card number can briefly disagree mid-scrub.
Pre-existing from iteration_2: the pinned card is shorter than the reserved scene height, leaving a large empty band below the card.

critical_code_review_comments: stageIcons.tsx SVGs have no explicit width/height and rely on the caller's sizing class; they currently resolve to 20x20 which is correct, but adding a default size class would make them safe if reused elsewhere.

SectionWipe uses el.closest('section') as the ScrollTrigger trigger - correct today, but it silently falls back to the bar itself (a 1px element) if a wipe is ever placed outside a <section>, which would make the start/end window meaningless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No backend; preview URL only (Next.js dev, port 3000). Verified testids: hero h1, process-timeline, process-progress-counter (desktop), process-progress-counter-mobile (new, visible at 390), 7x [data-panel-card] each with one inline <svg>, client-type-0..2, cta-button, footer. SectionWipe bars are selectable via section span[aria-hidden="true"].h-px.origin-left (one each in #address, #beliefs, #process, #clients); note the page has ~23 total h-px spans so filter by .origin-left. Sample GSAP state with >=1.15s waits after window.scrollTo (scrub 0.6-1s).
